mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost per square foot for a home remodel in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Home remodeling costs in Orange County vary significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the specific area of the home being renovated. A basic cosmetic update might range from $25 to $75 per square foot, while a mid-range remodel with updated fixtures and finishes could be $75 to $150 per square foot. Major renovations, such as adding square footage, reconfiguring layouts, or luxury finishes, can exceed $150 per square foot. These are general estimates; a detailed quote requires an on-site evaluation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodeling costs in Orange County typically range from $25 to over $150 per square foot, depending on the scope and materials. Basic updates are less, while major renovations cost more.
